values.note: Standard nonelectric site $26 a night (group site $65). One extra vehicle fits most sites at $8 a night, collected at the campground unless booked as an add-on.

values.note: Five of the ten family sites are reservable on recreation.gov (or 1-877-444-6777), five first-come; the opening week (May 15-21 in 2026) is a first-come season. A reserved site is held until noon the day after arrival.

values.note: Ten single-family sites (two families may double up, each paying a site fee) plus one group site; all back-in, listed maximum vehicle lengths 45 ft (8 sites) and 30 ft (2). One RV with tow vehicle per single site.

note: Small, quiet Hiawatha NF campground in a classic pine forest on 32.5-acre Island Lake, about 12 mi south of Munising via Forest Highway 13 and FR 2268/2254/2557; lighter use than most, with a boat slip for small carry-in boats and canoes and shore fishing. Off-road vehicles may ride in and out of the campground (in and out only), with ATV trails nearby; the campground road is narrow and one-way. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Oct 15, 2026; off-season 'Site Closed') + recreation.gov + RIDB: $26 standard site (confirmed), reservable on recreation.gov with some first-come sites and a first-come opening week (fcfs/platform/14-night max new), season May 15 - Sep 7 (new), no electric (confirmed), 10 family sites + 1 group site (count 11 -> 10), back-in to 45 ft (new), vault toilets + potable water (confirmed). 'Federal Recreation Passes are accepted' does not state a camping discount, so discounts were left. Phone 906-387-2512 matches the FS page. No Hiawatha alert or order names Island Lake or its forest roads. Note trimmed of field restatements.
